 4m ago 16.56 EST Thank you very much for joining me. 
 Ewan Murray spent his night in St Gallen. I am not sure he enjoyed himself – here is his report.
 Switzerland roll over sorry Scotland to increase the pressure on Pocognoli Read more Share 12m ago 16.48 EST Today’s results … 
 League A - Group 2 
 Germany 5-0 Netherlands
 Greece 1-0 Serbia
 League B - Group 1 
 North Macedonia 0-3 Slovenia
 Switzerland 4-0 Scotland
 League C - Group 3 
 Faroe Islands 1-0 Moldova
 Kazakhstan 2-2 Slovakia
 League C - Group 4 
 Estonia 2-1 Bulgaria
 Iceland 3-0 Luxembourg
 League D - Group 1 
 Gibraltar 1-1 Malta
 League D - Group 2 
 Lithuania 2-1 Liechtenstein
 Share 13m ago 16.47 EST Sébastien Pocognoli looks like a man under pressure already. That was a poor performance tonight and the system does not look like it is working.
 Share 14m ago 16.46 EST Andy Robertson: “I thought first half we were in in the game, lost a stupid goal. We had chances could have been one each. Then by 50 minutes we were 3-0 down, that can’t happen in international football. A really tough night for us.
 “I don’t think you’ve got time in international football. We’ve not got time, we have to step up. We have a long break until March, which is not a good thing.“
 Share 20m ago 16.40 EST Germany top the group thanks to their win, and they will be joined in the quarter finals by Netherlands. 
 Share 21m ago 16.39 EST Full time: Switzerland 4-0 Scotland
 Scotland were made to look complete amateurs by the Swiss.
 Share 24m ago 16.36 EST GOAL! Switzerland 4-0 Scotland (Amdouni, 89)
 A short corner is defended awfully, even by Scotland’s standards, allowing Amdouni to fire home from an acre of space inside the box.
 View image in fullscreen Switzerland's Zeki Amdouni scores their side's fourth goal. Photograph: Andrew Milligan/PA Share Updated at  16.45 EST 24m ago 16.35 EST GOAL! North Macedonia 0-3 Slovenia (Sturm, 90+1)
 A second for Sturm.
 Share 25m ago 16.35 EST Full time: Germany 5-0 Netherlands
 It was a fine night for Gruda and Wirtz as a terrible Dutch side were mauled in Berlin.
 Share 26m ago 16.33 EST Switzerland 3-0 Scotland: Kristi Montgomery is sent on for his debut. Some good has come out of this misery.
 Share 28m ago 16.32 EST Germany 5-0 Netherlands: Van Bommel has looked lively down the left since coming on. He may get the Dutch player of the match for his efforts.
 Share 30m ago 16.30 EST Switzerland 3-0 Scotland: Almost the final disgrace for Scotland as Gunn rushes 40 yards out of his goal only to pass the ball straight to Sanches. The Swiss player seems confused by this so completely misses the open goal.
 Share 33m ago 16.26 EST GOAL! Gibraltar 1-1 Malta (Richards, 81)
 A huge goal. A fine assist from James Scanlon, too.
 Share 35m ago 16.24 EST Switzerland 3-0 Scotland: Amdouni cuts in from the left and flashes a shot across goal but wide.
 Share 38m ago 16.21 EST Germany 5-0 Netherlands: Verbruggen calls on the Dutch players to have a huddle to work out why they are so terrible. The goalkeeper is fuming and he is telling everyone about their appalling performances.
 Share 39m ago 16.20 EST GOAL! Germany 5-0 Netherlands (Gruda, 77)
 What a night for Gruda. The Dutch are ripped apart again. Scherhant thinks he has scored but the ball bounces off the post and straight to Gruda who smashes in.
 Share 41m ago 16.19 EST Switzerland 3-0 Scotland: McTominay has a great chance as the ball loops up perfectly to volley from about 10 yards but he smashes it over with all his might. He then swears a bit.
 Share 43m ago 16.16 EST GOAL! Greece 1-0 Serbia (Masouras, 69)
 We have lift-off.
 Share 44m ago 16.16 EST Germany 4-0 Netherlands: Gruda is brimming with confidence, so feels it is worthwhile trying one from distance. It has plenty of power but is pretty much straight at the goalkeeper who claims at the second time of asking.
 Share 45m ago 16.15 EST Germany 4-0 Netherlands: Verbruggen is absolutely fuming but I guess is you’re forced to play behind two Tottenham centre-backs, this is what you have to expect.
 Share 46m ago 16.14 EST GOAL! Germany 4-0 Netherlands (Wirtz, 71)
 Gruda and Wirtz have been fantastic tonight. They combine for the fourth, as the Liverpool playmaker thwacks home from close range. The Dutch are being pulled apart.
 Share 46m ago 16.13 EST Switzerland 3-0 Scotland: The Swiss have contrived to not score a fourth. First Ballet is through but cannot finish, then Amdouni struggles with the rebound.
 Share 49m ago 16.10 EST GOAL! North Macedonia 0-2 Slovenia (Zec, 66)
 Another game that seems all but over.
 Share 51m ago 16.08 EST GOAL! Germany 3-0 Netherlands (Schlotterbeck, 65)
 A lovely delivery from Gruda is attacked by Schlotterbeck who flicks into the corner with his noggin’.
 View image in fullscreen Nico Schlotterbeck of Germany celebrates scoring his team’s third goal with Jonathan Tah. Photograph: Stuart Franklin/Getty Images Share Updated at  16.17 EST 54m ago 16.06 EST Switzerland 3-0 Scotland: A triple substitute for the Scots as Gannon-Doak, Bowie and Christie are all sent on to see if they can perform a miracle.
 Share 1h ago 16.03 EST GOAL! Germany 2-0 Netherlands (Wirtz, 60)
 Who is this £100m+ player? The Liverpool man smashes home from 20 yards with this left foot. A stunning finish.
 Share 1h ago 16.01 EST Switzerland 3-0 Scotland: McTominay tries a bicycle kick but quickly realises the futility of life before he hits the deck, watching the ball float high in the process.
 Share 1h ago 16.00 EST Germany 1-0 Netherlands: Gakpo takes aim from the edge of the box, forcing Ter Stegen to push the ball out. Luckily for the hosts, a black shirt is first on the scene.
 Van Hecke catches Wirtz high with his studs. The Dutchman is being rather petulant here.
 Share 1h ago 15.59 EST Germany 1-0 Netherlands: Van Hecke is a huge fan of pettiness, proving it by giving Kimmich’s ribs a tickle for no reason.
 Share 1h ago 15.58 EST GOAL! Switzerland 3-0 Scotland (Sanches, 51)
 A dreadful start to the second half for Scotland as Sanches rifles a first-time shot across Gunn into the corner.
 View image in fullscreen Switzerland's Alvyn Sanches scores. Photograph: Michael Schmid/Keystone/AP Share Updated at  16.21 EST 1h ago 15.57 EST Germany 1-0 Netherlands: Gakpo goes on a big run and eventually wins a free-kick around 30 yards from goal. It is neatly worked but comes to nothing.
 Share 1h ago 15.56 EST GOAL! Switzerland 2-0 Scotland (Boteli, 47)
 The No 11 is claiming it after Ballet’s shot is already going in but the forward sticks his foot out to get the final touch. Is it worth it? There is a lengthy VAR check to see if Boteli is offside but he is just on.
 View image in fullscreen Switzerland's Winsley Boteli (centre left) celebrates scoring their side's second goal. Photograph: Andrew Milligan/PA Share Updated at  15.58 EST 1h ago 15.54 EST Germany 1-0 Netherlands: Gruda shimmies in from the right and then takes aim but his shot is a touch off and it goes wide from 20 yards.
 Share 1h ago 15.51 EST Germany 1-0 Netherlands: A cross from the left beats everyone and then bounces up perfectly for Dumfries to head but his efforts is too high.
 Share 1h ago 15.49 EST Germany 1-0 Netherlands: Scherhant barrels through the Dutch defence but then thwacks his shot over the bar from inside the box.
 Share 1h ago 15.48 EST Second half
 We go again!
 Share 1h ago 15.38 EST Half-time reading. 
 Tuchel and England must learn lessons of history, Seville and Southgateism | Barney Ronay Read more Share 1h ago 15.36 EST Half time: Switzerland 1-0 Scotland
 Lewis Ferguson will not want to see his own goal back ever.
 Share 1h ago 15.33 EST Switzerland 1-0 Scotland: Bajrami has a free header from a corner but 50ps it wide. Maybe that is not a good reference for our international audience, so to be clear it was a rubbish attempt.
 Share 1h ago 15.31 EST Half time: Germany 1-0 Netherlands
 A deserved lead for the Germans thanks to a fine goal.
 Share 1h ago 15.30 EST Switzerland 1-0 Scotland: A looping cross from Robertson is headed across goal by substitute Patterson to McGinn who has a great chance but tamely heads at the goalkeeper.
 Share 2h ago 15.28 EST Peter Oh knows: “According to the Kicker liveticker, the Germany kit commemorates the final match of the 70-year partnership with Adidas. Starting in 2027 it will be Nike for eight years.
 “If I were Adidas I would have made it black too, as in mourning.”
 Nice.
 Share 2h ago 15.27 EST GOAL! Germany 1-0 Netherlands (Scherhant, 41)
 The winger cuts in from the left and rifles his first international goal into the top corner. What a finish.
 View image in fullscreen Germany's Derry Scherhant scores his side's opening goal. Photograph: Markus Schreiber/AP Share Updated at  15.42 EST 2h ago 15.25 EST Switzerland 1-0 Scotland: Never nice seeing someone who has suffered from injuries down the years have to hobble off. He knew straightaway.
 Share 2h ago 15.24 EST Switzerland 1-0 Scotland: Hickey seems to have knack his hamstring heading the ball back to Gunn. Patterson primed.
 Share 2h ago 15.22 EST Switzerland 1-0 Scotland: Schmidt launches himself through the air in the desperate hope of performing a world class diving header but he does not have the neck of a giraffe, meaning he feels only the breeze of the ball passing his head.
 Share 2h ago 15.20 EST Germany 0-0 Netherlands: If you like niggly fouls, then this is the game for you because there has been loads.
 Share 2h ago 15.18 EST Germany 0-0 Netherlands: The hosts enjoy a rapid move that concludes with Scherhant powering a shot towards the corner, only to see it bounce wide off the post.
 Share 2h ago 15.17 EST Ian Copestake emails: “I did laugh when, hoping the Dutch grudge match might be on actual TV, saw it was Scotland. The funny bit was the screen then asking me if I wanted to watch from the start.”
 Share 2h ago 15.16 EST GOAL! North Macedonia 0-1 Slovenia (Sturm, 29)
 The Slovenians are in business.
 Share 2h ago 15.12 EST Switzerland 1-0 Scotland: Almost an immediately reply as Hickey flashes a header wide.
 Share 2h ago 15.12 EST Germany 0-0 Netherlands: Gakpo does well down the left and then pings a cross with all his might, meaning Malen cannot control the header with the goal gaping.
 Share 2h ago 15.11 EST GOAL! Switzerland 1-0 Scotland (Ferguson OG, 22)
 That is a relatively comical own goal from the midfielder. A tame cross comes in from the right so Ferguson decides to help out by toeing the ball into the corner.
 View image in fullscreen Scotland's goalkeeper Angus Gunn (L) dives but concedes the opening goal. Photograph: Fabrice Coffrini/AFP/Getty Images View image in fullscreen Scotland’s Lewis Ferguson reacts after scoring an own goal.
